source_statements.direct_wellFactorable_signedError_c2:
theorem direct_wellFactorable_signedError_c2
    {ι : Type*} {κ k i j : ℕ} (A : ℕ)
    {T : ι → ℝ} {N : ι → Finset ℕ} {β : ι → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hSW : BetaCoprimeSWFamily κ T N β) (hT : ∀ z, 1 ≤ T z)
    (hN : ∀ z, ∀ n ∈ N z, T z ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ 2*T z)
    (hβ : ∀ z, ∀ n ∈ N z, |β z n| ≤ (fouvryTau k n : ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ z : ι, ∀ M ν : ℝ,
      1 ≤ M → 4*M*T z = x → ε ≤ ν → ν ≤ 1/10 → T z = x^ν →
      ∀ U : Finset ℕ, (∀ n ∈ U, M ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ 2*M) →
      ∀ α c : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n ∈ U, |α n| ≤ (fouvryTau i n : ℝ)) →
      SignedWellFactorable j (x^((5-5*ν)/9-ε)) c →
      ∀ a : ℤ, a ≠ 0 → |(a : ℝ)| ≤ x →
      |signedError U (N z) (Ioc 0 ⌊x^((5-5*ν)/9-ε)⌋₊) α (β z) c a| ≤
        x/Real.log x^A

theorem primeC2_unconditional (i j A : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ z : PrimeC2Interval, ∀ M ν : ℝ,

source_statements.factorConvolution:
def factorConvolution (γ ζ : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ q.divisorsAntidiagonal, γ p.1 * ζ p.2
source_statements.factorSupported:
def factorSupported (R : ℝ) (γ : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n, γ n ≠ 0 → 0 < n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ R
source_statements.SignedWellFactorable:
def SignedWellFactorable (k : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ q, |c q| ≤ (fouvryTau k q : ℝ)) ∧
    ∀ R S : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → 1 ≤ S → R * S = L →
      ∃ γ ζ : ℕ → ℝ,
        factorSupported R γ ∧ factorSupported S ζ ∧
        (∀ r, |γ r| ≤ (fouvryTau k r : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ s, |ζ s| ≤ (fouvryTau k s : ℝ)) ∧ c = factorConvolution γ ζ

source_statements.BetaCoprimeSWFamily:
def BetaCoprimeSWFamily {ι : Type*} (κ : ℕ) (T : ι → ℝ)
    (N : ι → Finset ℕ) (β : ι → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ i : ι, ∀ d h : ℕ, 0 < d → 0 < h → ∀ b : ℕ, b.Coprime d →
      |betaCoprimeAPDiscrepancy (N i) (β i) d h b| ≤
        C * T i * (fouvryTau κ h : ℝ) / Real.log (2 * T i) ^ B

source_statements.coprimeMass:
def coprimeMass (N : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ N, if n.Coprime q then β n else 0
source_statements.bilinearDiscrepancy:
def bilinearDiscrepancy (M N : Finset ℕ) (α β : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) (q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ m ∈ M, ∑ n ∈ N,
      if Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a then α m * β n else 0) -
    (∑ m ∈ M, ∑ n ∈ N, if (m * n).Coprime q then α m * β n else 0) /
      (q.totient : ℝ)
source_statements.reducedModuli:
def reducedModuli (Q : Finset ℕ) (a : ℤ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Q.filter (fun q => Int.gcd a q = 1)
source_statements.signedError:
def signedError (M N Q : Finset ℕ) (α β c : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ reducedModuli Q a, c q * bilinearDiscrepancy M N α β a q

source_statements.fouvryTau: def fouvryTau (k : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℕ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta ^ k

source_statements.primeSWBeta: def primeSWBeta (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n.Prime then 1 else 0
source_statements.primeSWInterval: def primeSWInterval (u v : ℝ) : Finset ℕ := Ioc ⌊u⌋₊ ⌊v⌋₊

source_statements.weighted_primitive_bilinearTensor_explic:
theorem weighted_primitive_bilinearTensor_explicit
    (A : ℕ → ℤ → ℂ) (DS : Finset ℕ) (D M Q : ℕ)
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hcard : DS.card ≤ D) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
      ∑ χ : PrimitiveCharacter q,
        ‖bilinearTensorCharacterForm A DS M q χ‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (D : ℝ) * ((M : ℝ) + primitiveBilinearQFactor Q * (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        bilinearTensorCoeffEnergy A DS M

source_statements.bilinearTensorCharacterForm:
def bilinearTensorCharacterForm
    (A : ℕ → ℤ → ℂ) (DS : Finset ℕ) (M q : ℕ)
    (χ : PrimitiveCharacter q) : ℂ :=
  ∑ d ∈ DS, ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) M,
    A d t * χ.1 (d : ZMod q) * χ.1 (t : ZMod q)
source_statements.bilinearTensorCoeffEnergy:
def bilinearTensorCoeffEnergy
    (A : ℕ → ℤ → ℂ) (DS : Finset ℕ) (M : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d ∈ DS, ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) M, ‖A d t‖ ^ 2

theorem forall_exists_prime_gt_and_modEq (n : ℕ) {q a : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : a.Coprime q) :
    ∃ p > n, p.Prime ∧ p ≡ a [MOD q]

theorem siftedSum_le_mainSum_errSum_of_upperMoebius (muPlus : ℕ → ℝ) (h : IsUpperMoebius muPlus) :
    s.siftedSum ≤ s.totalMass * s.mainSum muPlus + s.errSum muPlus := calc
  s.siftedSum ≤ ∑ d ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes, muPlus d * multSum d :=
    siftedSum_le_sum_of_upperMoebius _ h
  _ = s.totalMass * mainSum muPlus + ∑ d ∈ divisors s.prodPrimes, muPlus d * s.rem d
